name: hud_sensor_tracker_set_objective_marker_color_blink
description: HudSensorTracker::SetObjectiveMarkerColorBlink recolors every map node matching an objective index and swaps the packed 565 full/half color pair to create the blinking marker color ordering.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HudSensor objective/map source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x417300 validates traversal from mapNodeListHead at tracker offset 0x40, objectiveIndex match at node offset 0x10, SetColorRgb(colorRgb24), packedColor565Pair load at node offset 0x20, 16-bit high/low half swap, next traversal at node offset 0, return 1, and callee stack cleanup for the two arguments.

The native HudSensor objective marker smoke verifies that matching nodes receive the blink color, their packed 565 pair is swapped to full-color high half and half-color low half, nonmatching nodes keep their previous packed color, and the method returns 1.
